title: Listening Drill — Locker key
description: Customer service dialogue. One recording, four questions. Synthetic audio.

sections.title: Locker key
sections.transcript:
CUSTOMER: I need some help with a missing locker key. The main problem is a jammed lock. I thought I could solve it myself, but the instructions don't cover what I've seen.

ADVISER: We can look into it. First please send the booking email. Then bring the item to the sports desk. If you go to the original collection point they will send you back here.

CUSTOMER: What happens if you can't sort it out while I'm there?

ADVISER: Ask for a temporary locker. leave your belongings where they are for now. Keep the confirmation until the issue has been closed.
